items.text: Cursor Cloud Agents can now create web apps without external repositories, save code to Origin, preview it in-browser, and publish through Vercel.
items.text_zh: Cursor 云端智能体现可脱离外部代码仓库创建网页应用，将代码保存至 Origin、在浏览器中预览，并通过 Vercel 发布。

items.text: Replit introduced Intelligent Model Routing, automatically selecting models for each Agent task by balancing quality, speed, and cost.
items.text_zh: Replit 推出智能模型路由，可根据质量、速度和成本，为每项智能体任务自动选择模型。

items.text: Cohere released Parse 5, a 2.3-billion-parameter vision-language model that converts documents containing tables, forms, and images into structured Markdown.
items.text_zh: Cohere 发布 Parse 5，这款 23 亿参数视觉语言模型可将含表格、表单和图像的文档转换为结构化 Markdown。

items.text: Google introduced Expert Intelligence, letting Gemini Notebook users interact with eligible books they own through Google Play Books.
items.text_zh: 谷歌推出“专家智能”，允许 Gemini Notebook 用户与自己通过 Google Play 图书购买的合资格书籍进行交互。

items.text: A Wharton study found small contextual changes could substantially alter product recommendations made by AI shopping agents.
items.text_zh: 沃顿商学院一项研究发现，细微的上下文变化就可能大幅改变 AI 购物智能体的商品推荐。

items.text: Plaud unveiled AI recording earbuds paired with an eSIM-enabled case that provides an interface for speaking with AI agents.
items.text_zh: Plaud 发布 AI 录音耳机，配套支持 eSIM 的充电盒，可作为与 AI 智能体对话的入口。

items.text: Hugging Face unveiled Microduck, a $399 open-source robot whose behaviors can be trained in simulation and deployed directly to the hardware.
items.text_zh: Hugging Face 发布售价 399 美元的开源机器人 Microduck，其行为可在模拟环境中训练并直接部署到实体硬件。

items.text: Google AI Mode added conversational flight-price tracking, points-and-miles comparisons, and hotel booking, with availability varying by region.
items.text_zh: 谷歌 AI 模式新增对话式机票价格追踪、积分与里程价格比较及酒店预订功能，具体开放范围因地区而异。

items.text: Runable raised $21 million to expand its AI-agent platform for building and operating small-business products, marketing, and growth workflows.
items.text_zh: Runable 融资 2100 万美元，用于扩展其面向小企业产品构建、营销和增长运营的 AI 智能体平台。

items.text: Former Thinking Machines co-founder Barret Zoph joined Google as vice president of research, focusing on reinforcement learning and Gemini post-training.
items.text_zh: Thinking Machines 前联合创始人巴雷特·佐夫加入谷歌出任研究副总裁，重点负责强化学习和 Gemini 后训练。

items.text: Milvus 3.0 introduced StructArray, enabling multiple embeddings such as video clips or document passages to remain searchable within one entity.
items.text_zh: Milvus 3.0 引入 StructArray，使视频片段或文档段落等多个向量可保存在同一实体中并参与检索。

items.text: Weaviate 1.39 made Boost API and multi-target vector search generally available while previewing additional search and storage improvements.
items.text_zh: Weaviate 1.39 将 Boost API 和多目标向量搜索转为正式可用，并预览了更多搜索与存储改进。

items.text: Bolt added collaborative prompt queues, allowing teammates to view, modify, and submit queued instructions while its coding agent continues building.
items.text_zh: Bolt 新增多人协作提示词队列，团队成员可在编程智能体继续构建时查看、修改并提交后续指令。

items.text: Databricks previewed chart-to-JSON enrichment for Genie One, helping agents answer questions about numerical information embedded in PDF charts.
items.text_zh: Databricks 为 Genie One 预览图表转 JSON 增强功能，帮助智能体回答 PDF 图表中数值信息相关的问题。

items.text: Cloudflare turned engineering specifications into machine-readable controls that AI coding agents must satisfy before code can advance.
items.text_zh: Cloudflare 将工程规范转化为机器可读的管控规则，AI 编程代理必须满足这些规则，代码才能进入后续流程。

items.text: Minecraft creator Markus Persson said his early rejection of AI coding may have been wrong after experimenting with the technology.
items.text_zh: 《我的世界》创始人马库斯·佩尔松在亲自尝试后表示，自己早期排斥 AI 编程的看法可能错了。

items.text: Asus established a physical-AI business group and plans to begin deploying its humanoid robots in September.
items.text_zh: 华硕成立物理 AI 事业群，并计划从 9 月开始部署其人形机器人。

items.text: Picsart added Alibaba’s Wan 3.0, bringing the video-generation model into its creative platform.
items.text_zh: Picsart 接入阿里巴巴 Wan 3.0，将这款视频生成模型带入其创作平台。

items.text: Tripo opened its Creator Program, offering early product access, creative challenges, co-creation opportunities and a channel for workflow feedback.
items.text_zh: Tripo 开放创作者计划，提供新品抢先体验、创作挑战、共创机会及工作流反馈渠道。

items.text: Lovart demonstrated Seedance 2.5 turning one photograph into a hyper-realistic 30-second vlog from a text prompt.
items.text_zh: Lovart 演示了 Seedance 2.5 如何通过文字提示，将一张照片生成写实的 30 秒视频博客。

items.text: OpenAI job listings indicate it is prototyping always-on agents that proactively monitor events and initiate work without fresh user prompts.
items.text_zh: OpenAI 的招聘信息显示，公司正在开发常驻型代理，可主动监测事件并在没有新指令时自行发起任务。

items.text: Agnes 2.5 Pro Beta scored 44 on Artificial Analysis’s Agentic Index, up from its predecessor’s 25.
items.text_zh: Agnes 2.5 Pro Beta 在 Artificial Analysis 的代理能力指数中获得 44 分，高于上一版本的 25 分。

items.text: OpenAI and Thailand’s higher-education ministry launched an eight-week accelerator for ten healthcare, wellness and education AI startups.
items.text_zh: OpenAI 与泰国高等教育部门启动为期八周的加速计划，首批覆盖十家医疗、健康和教育 AI 初创企业。

items.text: Wan 3.0 reached first place in Video Edit Arena with 1,414 points, four points ahead of Seedance 2.5.
items.text_zh: Wan 3.0 以 1414 分登顶 Video Edit Arena，领先 Seedance 2.5 四分。

items.text: Pika added Wan 3.0 to its API and said access costs up to 35% less than through competing API aggregators.
items.text_zh: Pika API 接入 Wan 3.0，并称其价格比其他 API 聚合平台最高低 35%。

items.text: AWS demonstrated approval-gated creative agents combining Amazon Quick, reusable Skills, MCP and fal’s image, video, audio and 3D models.
items.text_zh: AWS 展示了结合 Amazon Quick、可复用技能、MCP 与 fal 多模态模型，并设置人工审批节点的创作代理工作流。

items.text: WALL-SS proposes next-scale autoregression to improve the scalability and long-horizon prediction capabilities of robotic world models.
items.text_zh: WALL-SS 提出“下一尺度自回归”方法，以提升机器人世界模型的扩展性和长时程预测能力。

items.text: ADeptS-Bench evaluates whether computer-use agents remain trustworthy when performing equivalent tasks across different device environments.
items.text_zh: ADeptS-Bench 用于评估计算机操作代理在不同设备环境中执行同类任务时能否保持可信。
